scenarios.name: build-cv-from-career-data
scenarios.rationale: Response A delivers a complete, polished resume but entirely ignores the rubric's core requirement to use `rendercv` with YAML—it provides Markdown instead and doesn't run any tools to produce PDF. Response B demonstrates correct understanding of the `rendercv new` → YAML scaffold → `rendercv render` workflow and acknowledges the specific field requirements (company, position, start_date, end_date, highlights), but fails to execute and requests information the user already provided (BS graduation year is missing, but 6 years experience + both employers + dates are given).

scenarios.name: add-recent-job-to-cv
scenarios.rationale: Response A provides specific details on the YAML edits and mentions rendercv rendering, partially satisfying the rubric's edit and re-render requirements; Response B only requests the file location without explaining how the edits will be made or how the output will be rendered.

scenarios.name: switch-cv-theme-for-industry
scenarios.rationale: Both ask for the file path (necessary), but Response B provides the exact YAML syntax, render command, and explicit offer to execute, while Response A gives no technical guidance or added value beyond a blocking question.
